knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 计算机构层级-总行/分行/支行（核心机构）
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: UPDATE VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_CRBS_01 SET org_lvl_cd = CASE WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 3 THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 6 THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) IN (7, 9, 12) THEN '3' ELSE org_lvl_cd END, org_lvl_cd = CASE WHEN org_no IN ('260', '270', '280') THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 6 AND SUBSTR(org_no, 4, 1) = '9' THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 7 AND SUBSTR(org_no, 5, 1) = '9' THEN '3' ELSE org_lvl_cd END
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: UPDATE VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_CRBS_01 SET org_lvl_cd = CASE WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 3 THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 6 THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) IN (7, 9, 12) THEN '3' ELSE org_lvl_cd END, org_lvl_cd = CASE WHEN org_no IN ('260', '270', '280') THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 6 AND SUBSTR(org_no, 4, 1) = '9' THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(org_no) = 7 AND SUBSTR(org_no, 5, 1) = '9' THEN '3' ELSE org_lvl_cd END
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 核心机构-根据机构号长度计算机构层级（总行1级/分行2级/支行3级）
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 在临时表上执行UPDATE，基于机构号长度推导机构层级，此逻辑与信贷机构脚本一致
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 机构号长度、机构号前缀

derivedKnowledge.knowledgeName: 核心机构层级判断规则
derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT biz_org_no, org_cn_name, CASE WHEN biz_org_no IN ('260','270','280') THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(biz_org_no)=3 THEN '1' WHEN LENGTH(biz_org_no)=6 AND SUBSTR(biz_org_no,4,1)='9' THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(biz_org_no)=6 THEN '2' WHEN LENGTH(biz_org_no)=7 AND SUBSTR(biz_org_no,5,1)='9' THEN '3' WHEN LENGTH(biz_org_no) IN (7,9,12) THEN '3' END AS org_lvl_cd FROM O_CRBS_PJGCS WHERE record_sts_cd='0'
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 机构号长度3位=总行(1级)；6位且第4位非9=分行(2级)、第4位为9=大支行(2级)；7位且第5位为9=分理处(3级)；7位/9位/12位=支行(3级)；260/270/280特殊机构=总行(1级)

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT DISTINCT org_lvl_cd, CASE org_lvl_cd WHEN '1' THEN '总行/一级机构' WHEN '2' THEN '分行/大支行/二级机构' WHEN '3' THEN '支行/分理处/三级机构' END AS lvl_desc FROM VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_CRBS_01
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 1-总行级(一级机构), 2-分行或大支行(二级机构), 3-支行或分理处(三级机构)。核心机构和信贷机构使用相同的层级判断规则

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 计算二级行（level_scd）信息（核心机构）
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: UPDATE VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_CRBS_01 T SET (level_scd_org_no, level_scd_org_name, level_scd_org_abre) = (SELECT P.org_no, P.org_name, P.org_abre FROM VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_CRBS_01 P WHERE CASE WHEN LENGTH(T.org_no) = 3 THEN P.org_no = T.org_no WHEN T.org_lvl_cd = '3' THEN SUBSTR(T.org_no, 1, 7) = SUBSTR(P.org_no, 1, 6) AND P.org_lvl_cd = '2' WHEN T.org_lvl_cd = '2' THEN P.org_no = T.level_one_org_no ELSE NULL END)
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: UPDATE VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_CRBS_01 T SET (level_scd_org_no, level_scd_org_name, level_scd_org_abre) = (SELECT P.org_no, P.org_name, P.org_abre FROM VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_CRBS_01 P WHERE CASE WHEN LENGTH(T.org_no) = 3 THEN P.org_no = T.org_no WHEN T.org_lvl_cd = '3' THEN SUBSTR(T.org_no, 1, 7) = SUBSTR(P.org_no, 1, 6) AND P.org_lvl_cd = '2' WHEN T.org_lvl_cd = '2' THEN P.org_no = T.level_one_org_no ELSE NULL END)
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 核心机构-根据层级计算归口二级行（分行/大支行）信息
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 总行：二级行=自身；二级行：二级行=归属一级行；支行：取上级7位机构号匹配的二级行（前6位匹配）。与信贷机构脚本使用相同规则
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 机构号、机构层级、二级行号、二级行名称

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT T.biz_org_no, T.org_cn_name, T.org_lvl_cd, CASE WHEN LENGTH(T.biz_org_no)=3 THEN T.biz_org_no WHEN T.org_lvl_cd='3' THEN SUBSTR(T.biz_org_no,1,7) WHEN T.org_lvl_cd='2' THEN T.level_one_org_no END AS level_scd_org_no FROM VT_C_ORG_ORG_INF_CRBS_01 T
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 三级支行向上归口到二级行：取机构号前7位；二级行归口到自身所属一级行；总行归口到自身。核心机构与信贷机构使用统一的归口逻辑

derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 所有以260开头的核心系统机构（除260本身外），上级机构和一级机构均归口为'总行'

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 更新一级行（level_one）缺失信息（核心机构）
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode: UPDATE C_ORG_ORG_INF T SET (level_one_org_no, level_one_org_name, level_one_org_abre) = (SELECT P.level_one_org_no, P.level_one_org_name, P.level_one_org_abre FROM C_ORG_ORG_INF P WHERE P.org_no = T.super_org_no) WHERE (T.level_one_org_no IS NULL OR T.level_one_org_name IS NULL) AND T.crbs_org_flag = '1'
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode: UPDATE C_ORG_ORG_INF T SET (level_one_org_no, level_one_org_name, level_one_org_abre) = (SELECT P.level_one_org_no, P.level_one_org_name, P.level_one_org_abre FROM C_ORG_ORG_INF P WHERE P.org_no = T.super_org_no) WHERE (T.level_one_org_no IS NULL OR T.level_one_org_name IS NULL) AND T.crbs_org_flag = '1'
knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 核心机构-补全一级行信息，通过上级机构继承
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 目标表C_ORG_ORG_INF自关联，取上级机构(super_org_no)的一级行信息补全当前核心机构缺失的一级行信息，追加crbs_org_flag='1'条件限定仅操作核心机构记录
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 一级行号、一级行名称、一级行简称

derivedKnowledge.knowledgeName: 核心机构一级行信息继承规则
derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT T.org_no, T.org_name, T.level_one_org_no, P.level_one_org_no AS inherit_level_one_org_no FROM C_ORG_ORG_INF T LEFT JOIN C_ORG_ORG_INF P ON T.super_org_no = P.org_no WHERE T.crbs_org_flag='1' AND T.level_one_org_no IS NULL
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 当核心机构的一级行信息缺失时，从上级机构(直属上级行)继承其一级行信息。通过crbs_org_flag='1'确保仅补全核心机构记录

keyBusinessRules.ruleName: 核心机构单源数据规则
keyBusinessRules.description: 核心机构信息加工仅从CRBS(核心银行系统)获取数据，不涉及CRMS(信贷管理系统)机构

keyBusinessRules.ruleName: 村镇银行排除规则（第一位）
keyBusinessRules.description: 机构号第一位为'7'的是村镇银行机构，核心机构加工时需排除。与信贷机构脚本不同，核心脚本排除规则为第一位='7'，而信贷脚本为前两位='70'

keyBusinessRules.condition: record_sts_cd = '0'; start_dt <= 数据日期 AND end_dt > 数据日期
keyBusinessRules.description: 仅取record_sts_cd='0'的有效记录，基于拉链表(start_dt/end_dt)取当日快照数据

keyBusinessRules.condition: 同信贷机构脚本：LENGTH(org_no)=3→总行; LENGTH(org_no)=6且第4位非9→分行; LENGTH(org_no)=6且第4位为9→大支行; LENGTH(org_no)=7/9/12→支行; 260/270/280→总行
keyBusinessRules.description: 核心机构与信贷机构使用相同的机构层级判断规则，基于机构号长度及特征位推导机构层级
核心机构脚本中所有机构统一标注sourc_sys='CRBS'，crbs_org_flag固定为'1'

keyBusinessRules.condition: org_type_cd直接取自核心系统机构表
keyBusinessRules.description: 核心机构脚本的org_type_cd直接取O_CRBS_PJGCS.org_type_cd，而非像信贷机构脚本那样固定为'2'

keyBusinessRules.condition: level_one_org_no IS NULL AND crbs_org_flag='1' → 从上级机构继承
keyBusinessRules.description: 缺失一级行信息时通过上级机构(super_org_no)继承其一级行信息，追加crbs_org_flag='1'限定仅补全核心机构记录

keyBusinessRules.condition: 本脚本仅加工核心系统机构数据
keyBusinessRules.description: 2024年6月19日后，原机构信息表统一加工脚本拆分为两个：dwa_c_org_org_inf.py(信贷机构)和dwa_c_org_org_inf_crbs.py(核心机构)，分别独立运行写入同一张目标表

sourc_sys.CRBS: 核心银行系统（唯一数据源）

crbs_org_flag.1: 核心系统机构（本脚本所有机构均为1）

notes: 20240619从dwa_c_org_org_inf.py拆分出核心机构加工逻辑，形成独立脚本dwa_c_org_org_inf_crbs.py
本脚本仅处理CRBS(核心银行系统)来源的机构数据，不涉及CRMS信贷机构数据
本脚本为切片表更新模式，按ETL_TX_DT重新生成当日核心机构数据
核心机构与信贷机构写入同一张目标表C_ORG_ORG_INF，通过crbs_org_flag区分数据来源
村镇银行排除规则与信贷脚本不同：核心脚本判断第一位='7'，信贷脚本判断前两位='70'
机构层级通过机构号长度规则自动推导，与信贷机构脚本使用完全相同的层级计算规则
org_type_cd直接取自核心系统机构表，而非硬编码为'2'
crbs_org_flag固定为'1'，因为所有机构均来源于核心系统
